verdict.rationale: Vercel runs a public Atlassian Statuspage at vercel-status.com with an incident history feed, dated per-incident timelines (Investigating/Identified/Resolved), and permanent incident pages, so a devops lead can review past incidents before committing. The evidence shows only status-update timelines, not root-cause postmortems, so the postmortem part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented root-cause postmortems or retrospectives on incident pages, uptime-history metrics on the status page, and independent corroboration of postmortem depth.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can check a public status page with historical incident postmortems before committing

citations.quote: Vercel's public status page (Atlassian Statuspage) publishes an incident history feed titled "Vercel Status - Incident History" at vercel-status.com, with dated per-incident timelines (Investigating/Identified/Resolved updates) and permanent incident pages
